data.name: Pastory_Desc1
data.value: Have you ever copied something important, only to accidentally overwrite it a second later? Pastory is the lightweight, native clipboard manager for macOS that remembers everything you copy, so you don't have to.

data.name: Pastory_Desc2
data.value: Sitting quietly in your menu bar, Pastory keeps a secure, easily accessible history of your copied texts, links, and snippets. It stays completely out of your way until the exact moment you need it.

data.name: Pastory_Feature1Desc
data.value: Lives exclusively in your macOS menu bar. No messy dock icons or heavy windows interrupting your workflow.

data.name: Pastory_Feature2Desc
data.value: Built natively with Swift and SwiftUI to ensure fluid performance and minimal battery consumption.

data.name: Pastory_Feature3Desc
data.value: Everything you copy is stored locally on your Mac. No external servers, no cloud tracking, and no accounts required.

data.name: Pastory_ProDesc
data.value: Pastory is completely free to download and use for your essential daily history (up to 30 recent items). Need more power? Upgrade to Pastory Pro with a single, one-time purchase to unlock your full productivity.

data.name: Pastory_ProFeature1Desc
data.value: Store an endless stream of copied items.

data.name: Pastory_ProFeature2Desc
data.value: Instantly find specific clips from days or weeks ago.

data.name: Pastory_ProFeature3Desc
data.value: Clear old clip history after a couple days.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_Intro
data.value: At Pastory, your privacy is our top priority. We believe that what you copy should stay exactly where it belongs: on your own device.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_P1
data.value: Pastory operates entirely locally on your macOS device. Everything you copy—texts, links, snippets, and images—is stored directly on your computer's local storage. We do not use external servers, cloud databases, or any third-party storage solutions to store your clipboard history.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_P2
data.value: We do not track, collect, or analyze the contents of your clipboard. There are no analytics trackers embedded in Pastory that monitor your usage or send data back to us or any third parties.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_P3
data.value: Pastory does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide any personal information to use the app. It is designed to be completely anonymous and standalone.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_P4
data.value: To function correctly as a clipboard manager, Pastory requires specific macOS permissions to read your system clipboard. This permission is used exclusively for the core functionality of the app and never for data collection.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_P5
data.value: You have full control over your data. You can clear your entire clipboard history at any time directly from the app's preferences. For Pastory Pro users, the Smart Cleaning feature automatically removes old items based on your preferences, ensuring your storage remains clean and secure.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_P6
data.value: If we decide to change our privacy policy, we will post those changes on this page. However, our core commitment to keeping your data local and secure will never change.

data.name: PastoryPrivacy_Contact
data.value: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us.
